# ROLE STRUCTURE
> The [bold][color=yellow]Seraph [/bold][/color] is the highest ranking role within the in-sector MAWC hierarchy. These employees are expected to enact the corporate's goals with efficiency. They are able to order all ranks below them to their word, and may exercise additional authority within reason to get what they need done.
> [bold][color=yellow]Acolytes[/bold][/color] serve as the [bold][color=yellow]Seraph's[/bold][/color] right hand men, and are the true employees of the corporation. Excelling in many tasks, [bold]Acolytes[/bold] are front-line middle managers that guide [bold]carpenters[/bold] and [bold]initiates[/bold] for the seraph's goals. They are expected to make up for gaps in command and are responsible for directing the grunts.
> [bold][color=yellow]Carpenters[/bold][/color] are specialized employees of lower rank to acolytes. They serve to maintain [bold][color=red]Aurora[/bold][/color], Gather salvage and debris, and ensure the corporation's navy in-sector functions with efficiency and ideal logistical capability.
> [bold][color=yellow]Initiates[/bold][/color] are low-ranking grunt fodder. While actual power may vary, most are non-hydrakins or non-lizards who chose to enlist willingly into the ranks of the corporation, and so are used to fill in for everything else, such as logistics, menial labor and being the front-line cannonfodder. Special priveleges may apply as needed to them. [bold]Expendable[/bold].
